body: Agree with the reasoning. Additionally, for the few times users may want to use the history panel, it is unlikely that it concerns file operations anyway.

You basically summarised word-by-word what I was thinking when I "casually" made that suggestion. It was not truly "casual" because I have been thinking about it for quite a while, but...

There's also one more reason that's not mentioned among @Ivorforce's: I don't think the **History** dock deserves that much vertical space to be displayed. While the history can go pretty far back in time, most users will only really be interested in the top-most options in the list (the most recent **EditorUndoRedo** actions).

Anyway, that's why I approve from an usability standpoint.

However, let's be wary of a few considerations before getting this merged:
- This will ruin some users' workflow, which is absolutely inevitable for any change of this kind.
	- We should merge this sooner than later, evaluate the feedback, and see if it matches our reasoning and expectations.
	- It is fairly intuitive for the user to move the **History** dock back where it used to be after this PR, if absolutely desired.
- You can easily debate that, for several reasons, the History dock could be hidden by default, instead.
	- I must heavily note that doing this would serve little to no purpose for the time being, if not just to declutter the editor. There must be a good reason to do so (for example, space for a new dock in its place).
	- [Since its introduction](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/65012), the original author [does not have a particular fondness](https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/editor-design?msg=NAR3SyvM32Nn5ysvY) of the **History** dock (😭)
	- Let's remember that no one is arguing to _remove_ the **History** dock. This is not an option; the **History** dock has proven to be useful, albeit niche.
Looks good! Just needs a rebase after #101787's merge
